Footer.description: Empowering the next generation of DNS administrators through hands-on, risk-free learning experiences.

About.mission-description: ZeroCentDNS is committed to democratizing {{highlight}}DNS education{{/highlight}}. We believe that everyone should have access to hands-on learning opportunities without financial barriers.
About.edufirst-description: Every feature is designed with learning in mind, providing clear feedback and educational resources.
About.efficiency-description: Clean, intuitive interface that focuses on what matters most - your learning experience.
About.community-driver-description: Built for and supported by the open-source community, students, and educational institutions.
About.partnership-details: Even the smallest step, taken together, can lead to great progress.

Hero.risk-free-description: ZeroCentDNS provides a safe educational environment to master DNS concepts through delegated subdomains. Perfect for students, developers, and businesses exploring DNS.

Features.edufocus-description: Designed specifically for learning DNS concepts in a safe, controlled environment.
Features.for-everyone-description: Perfect for students, developers, open-source community, and small businesses.
Features.full-dns-control-description: Practice configuring A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, and other DNS record types.
Features.6month-description: Each subdomain remains active for 6 months, ensuring efficient resource usage.
Features.nocost-description: No cost, no commitment. Learn without the fear of breaking production systems.
Features.handson-description: Get practical experience before investing in your own top-level domain.
Features.why-description: A comprehensive platform designed to make DNS learning accessible, practical, and completely free for everyone.

Dashboard.hero-desc: An isolated subdomain with a live authoritative DNS server. Configure records, test resolution, and monitor queries in real-time.
Dashboard.features-title: What Can You Do in ZeroCentDNS Sandbox?
Dashboard.feat-stream-desc: Inspect every UDP & TCP DNS query hitting your nameserver live via Server-Sent Events.
Dashboard.feat-instant-desc: Changes to A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, and MX records reflect immediately on authoritative servers.
Dashboard.feat-parental-desc: Turn your sandbox into a custom DNS resolver with content filtering for families.
Dashboard.feat-tester-desc: Run dig queries directly from your browser without opening a local terminal.
Dashboard.confirm-new-subdomain: Are you sure you want to create a new subdomain? Your old subdomain and all its DNS records will be permanently deleted.
Dashboard.records-desc: Configure authoritative DNS records for your subdomain
Dashboard.records-empty: No records configured yet. Add your first record above.
Dashboard.stream-desc: Streaming queries in real-time as resolvers query your domain
Dashboard.stream-empty: Waiting for DNS queries. Run a dig query or configure your device to see requests stream in real-time.
Dashboard.tester-desc: Query authoritative nameserver directly from your browser
Dashboard.exp-desc: Interactive scenarios to understand how DNS records and resolution work
Dashboard.parental-desc: DNS resolver with content filtering for adult content, gambling, ads, and malware.
Dashboard.parental-cat-desc: Automatic filters based on security and content categories
Dashboard.parental-safesearch-desc: Safe search on Google, YouTube, Bing
Dashboard.parental-custom-allow-desc: Domains allowed even if in a blocked category
Dashboard.parental-test-desc: Test domain queries against your Parental Control DNS server
Dashboard.parental-setup-desc: Guide for configuring Private DNS & DoH on your devices
Dashboard.parental-setup-browser-1: Open Settings > Privacy and Security > Security.
Dashboard.parental-setup-ios-desc: Use a DNS profile app (such as DNSCloak or Apple Configurator) and enter your DoH URL:
Dashboard.parental-setup-router-1: Standard routers (UDP port 53) cannot use specific profiles using IP addresses.
Dashboard.parental-setup-router-2: You must use a modern router (like OpenWrt, Asuswrt-Merlin, Mikrotik) that supports DNS-over-TLS (DoT) or DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH).
Dashboard.parental-setup-router-3: Configure the DoT/DoH endpoint using the Private DNS Hostname or DoH URL provided above.
Dashboard.parental-setup-router-4: If your router does not support encrypted DNS, please configure the DNS directly on the connected devices (Android, iOS, PC).
Dashboard.parental-dot-ipv6-note: Private DNS (DoT) is now fully supported on port 853. Works on any network — IPv4 or IPv6. For browsers & iOS, use the DoH URL instead.
